question: Who was conferred a gold medal in 1968 by the Mexican government for her choreography?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mrinalini Sarabhai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai was an acclaimed Indian classical dancer and choreographer.
 
• She was honored with the gold medal in 1968 by the Mexican government for her exceptional contributions to choreography.
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai was the founder of the Darpana Academy of Performing Arts in Ahmedabad, India.
 
• She was trained in Bharatanatyam, Kathakali, and Mohiniyattam, which she often incorporated into her choreographic works.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam**

 
 
• A major form of Indian classical dance that originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali**
 
 
• A classical Indian dance-drama originating from Kerala, characterized by elaborate costumes and detailed gestures.
 
• It combines dance, acting, and music to depict stories from Hindu epics.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam**
 
 
• A classical dance form from Kerala, known for its graceful and slow movements.
 
• Traditionally performed by women and revolves around the theme of love and devotion.
 
 
 
• **Darpana Academy of Performing Arts**
 
 
• Founded by Mrinalini Sarabhai in 1949 in Ahmedabad.
 
• It is a premier institution for training in various forms of Indian dance and theater.
